nodes.name: colors.js
nodes.summary: Color palette utility under frappe.ui.color. Provides named color maps, get_color(name), get_color_name(hex), get_contrast_color, hex<->rgb conversions, lighten/darken, validate_hex, and compute_contrast_ratio. Used throughout desk for indicator colors and theming.

nodes.name: datatable.js
nodes.summary: Thin shim that imports frappe-datatable and attaches it to window so the desk DataTable widget is globally available.

nodes.name: dialog.js
nodes.summary: Defines frappe.ui.Dialog, the base modal class used across the desk. Subclasses FieldGroup to embed form fields and adds modal chrome (title, primary/secondary actions, alerts, minimize, custom buttons, focus management).

nodes.name: driver.js
nodes.summary: Shim that imports driver.js library for guided product tours and exposes it on window.

nodes.name: dropdown_console.js
nodes.summary: Implements an in-browser dropdown command console used for running frappe commands/snippets. Captures output, renders results, handles history and auto-complete within a popup overlay.

nodes.name: field_group.js
nodes.summary: Defines frappe.ui.FieldGroup, which extends frappe.ui.form.Layout to render a group of form fields inside dialogs and custom UIs. Provides get_values/set_values, validation, and field-by-fieldname lookup. Parent class of Dialog.

nodes.name: filters/field_select.js
nodes.summary: Defines frappe.ui.FieldSelect, an autocomplete widget for choosing a field from a doctype (including child tables and standard fields) when building filters.

nodes.name: filters/filter.js
nodes.summary: Defines frappe.ui.Filter, the single-row filter editor. Handles operator/field/value controls, value rendering based on fieldtype, condition normalization, and integration with a parent FilterGroup (filter_list).

nodes.name: filters/filter_list.js
nodes.summary: Defines frappe.ui.FilterGroup, the multi-row filter builder UI. Manages a list of frappe.ui.Filter instances, add/remove/clear, apply-to-list, and serialization to/from the URL or list view settings.

nodes.name: find.js
nodes.summary: Tiny helper to open the global find/search dialog via frappe.ui.toolbar; wires a keyboard shortcut to focus the search bar.

nodes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
nodes.summary: Modal dialog class. Extends FieldGroup so its body is a form field layout. Exposes make(), show()/hide(), set_title, set_primary_action, set_secondary_action, set_message/alert, add_custom_action, minimize, focus handling.

nodes.name: frappe.ui.FieldGroup
nodes.summary: Extends frappe.ui.form.Layout to host a standalone set of fields. Provides get_values (with validation), set_values, get_field, and helpers for dialogs and ad-hoc forms.

nodes.name: frappe.ui.FieldSelect
nodes.summary: Autocomplete widget that lets users pick a field from a doctype (including child-table and standard columns) for use in filter builders.

nodes.name: frappe.ui.Filter
nodes.summary: Single-row filter editor handling field selection, operator selection, and value control rendering based on fieldtype; emits apply/remove events to the parent FilterGroup.

nodes.name: frappe.ui.FilterGroup
nodes.summary: Multi-row filter builder that manages a collection of Filter instances, add/remove/clear, serialize to/from route, and apply to list views.
